info.name: Airline Code Lookup air-traffic Search API
Amadeus Returns a List of Hotels Matching a Given Keyword.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Location query keyword

params.name: subType
params.description:
Category of search - To enter several values, repeat the query parameter 
Use HOTEL_LEISURE to target aggregators or HOTEL_GDS to target directly the chains

params.name: countryCode
params.description: The country in which you search the subType. Country Code in [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) format

params.name: lang
params.description:
The language in which you want the results in following [ISO 639-1](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liste_des_codes_ISO_639-1). 

If the language entered is not available then the results will be shown in the default language, English.

params.name: max
params.description: The number of results requested from 1 to 20

info.name: Amadeus Returns Points of Interest for a Given Location and Radius.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude (decimal coordinates)

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude (decimal coordinates)

params.name: radius
params.description: radius of the search in Kilometer. Can be from 0 to 20, default value is 1 Km.

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: maximum items in one page

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: start index of the requested page

params.name: categories
params.description:
category of the location. 

Multiple value can be selected using a comma i.e. SIGHTS, SHOPPING
